comparison.objective: Lock a floating guide rod at the carriage-defined end position and prove full travel.
comparison.physical_skill: Use carriage position to establish a rod location, lock it, then operate a crank.
comparison.success_condition: Carriage runs the slide’s full length and back without sticking after release; numeric rubric is missing.
comparison.reason: It validates guide alignment set by a carriage, whereas the candidate specifically tests resisting jam-nut reaction while preserving an angular screw stop.
